dialogues.jp: 時計を見る。
dialogues.en: I looked at the clock.
dialogues.text: I looked at the clock.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましが鳴るまで、まだ３０分ある。
dialogues.en: I still have 30 minutes before the alarm goes off.
dialogues.text: I still have 30 minutes before the alarm goes off.

dialogues.jp: 「今日の夢は……」
dialogues.en: "Today's dream was......"
dialogues.text: "Today's dream was......"

dialogues.jp: なんだか、言い知れない不安感が湧いてくる。
dialogues.en: The feeling of fear I had was indescribable.
dialogues.text: The feeling of fear I had was indescribable.

dialogues.jp:
まだ鳴っていない目覚ましのスイッチを切り、
制服に着替えて｛した／１階｝に下りる。
dialogues.en:
I turned the alarm off before it rung and got dressed into
my uniform and went downstairs.
dialogues.text:
I turned the alarm off before it rung and got dressed into
my uniform and went downstairs.

dialogues.jp: 朝食を摂る気になれず、そのまま学園に向かう。
dialogues.en:
I didn't feel like having breakfast, so I headed to the
school without eating.
dialogues.text:
I didn't feel like having breakfast, so I headed to the
school without eating.

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩……」
dialogues.en: "Moe-sempai......"
dialogues.text: "Moe-sempai......"

dialogues.jp: まだほとんど学生の姿のない桜並木を歩く。
dialogues.en:
The cherry blossom avenue was still empty, and there were
almost no students walking there.
dialogues.text:
The cherry blossom avenue was still empty, and there were
almost no students walking there.

dialogues.jp:
通学途中の桜の幹に背中を預け、舞い散る花び
らをぼんやり眺める。
dialogues.en:
I leaned against one of the trees and vaguely watched the
falling petals.
dialogues.text:
I leaned against one of the trees and vaguely watched the
falling petals.

dialogues.jp: 目の前をうちの学生が次々と歩いていく。
dialogues.en:
Students from my school began to pass by in front of me.
Some of them stared at me with curiosity, but I ignored them
and waited for one girl to show up.
dialogues.text:
Students from my school began to pass by in front of me.
Some of them stared at me with curiosity, but I ignored them
and waited for one girl to show up.

dialogues.jp:
不思議そうに眺めていく学生達を無視して、たっ
たひとりの女の子を待つ。

dialogues.en:
I stood up straight as I moved away from the tree and walked
to the middle of the avenue.
dialogues.text:
I stood up straight as I moved away from the tree and walked
to the middle of the avenue.

dialogues.jp: 幹から背中を離し、並木道の中央に足を進める。
dialogues.en: "Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「スー」
dialogues.en:
I stood in front of Moe-sempai and grabbed her hand that was
playing the xylophone.
dialogues.text:
I stood in front of Moe-sempai and grabbed her hand that was
playing the xylophone.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩」
dialogues.en: "Mmm...... what......? Asakura-kun......?"
dialogues.text: "Mmm...... what......? Asakura-kun......?"

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩の前に立ちふさがり、木琴を叩いている
手を掴む。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai woke up and looked at me with a surprised
expression.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai woke up and looked at me with a surprised
expression.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……なんでしょうか……」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... What is it......?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... What is it......?"

dialogues.jp: なんだか、そっけない口調。
dialogues.en: She sounded blunt.
dialogues.text: She sounded blunt.

dialogues.jp: 「話しが……あるんだけど」
dialogues.en: "I need to talk with you......"
dialogues.text: "I need to talk with you......"

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、何も言わず俺は桜並木の脇に移動
した。
dialogues.en: I spoke and moved to the side of the avenue.
dialogues.text: I spoke and moved to the side of the avenue.

dialogues.jp: 振り向くと、目の前に萌先輩がいる。
dialogues.en: When I turned back, Moe-sempai was right in front of me.
dialogues.text: When I turned back, Moe-sempai was right in front of me.

dialogues.jp: 黙って立っている萌先輩。どこか表情に乏しい。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai remained quiet. She didn't have a recognizable
expression on her face.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai remained quiet. She didn't have a recognizable
expression on her face.

dialogues.jp:
「最近、なんか様子が変だけど、何かあったん
　ですか？」
dialogues.en:
"You've been acting strange lately. Is there something
wrong?"
dialogues.text:
"You've been acting strange lately. Is there something
wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「……なんでもないです」
dialogues.en: "......No, there's nothing."
dialogues.text: "......No, there's nothing."

dialogues.jp: 答えながら、視線を合わせようとしない。
dialogues.en: She answered without looking at me.
dialogues.text: She answered without looking at me.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、現に今だって俺のこと、見てくれない
　じゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "But you're not even looking at my face now."
dialogues.text: "But you're not even looking at my face now."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「……どうしたんです？」
dialogues.en: "......What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "......What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くんには……」
dialogues.en: "It's not......"
dialogues.text: "It's not......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くんには、関係のないことですから」
dialogues.en: "It's none of your business."
dialogues.text: "It's none of your business."

dialogues.jp:
真剣な瞳に見つめられて、一瞬言葉をなくす。
こんな表情の萌先輩は初めて見た。
dialogues.en:
I lost my words as she looked at me with a serious face.
This was the first time I saw a face like that on her.
dialogues.text:
I lost my words as she looked at me with a serious face.
This was the first time I saw a face like that on her.

dialogues.jp:
「何言ってるんですか。俺たち、恋人同士じゃ
　ないですか……」
dialogues.en: "What are you saying? You're my girlfriend......"
dialogues.text: "What are you saying? You're my girlfriend......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「でも……ごめんなさい……」
dialogues.en: "But...... I'm sorry......"
dialogues.text: "But...... I'm sorry......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「もう会えません。会っちゃいけないんです」
dialogues.en: "I can't see you any more. I shouldn't see you any more."
dialogues.text: "I can't see you any more. I shouldn't see you any more."

dialogues.jp: 決意のこもった瞳ではっきりと呟く。
dialogues.en: She stated clearly with a determined look,
dialogues.text: She stated clearly with a determined look,

dialogues.jp: 「あ……そんなっ……どうして……」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「もう一度……会いたい人がいるから……」
dialogues.en: "I have someone...... Who I want to see again......"
dialogues.text: "I have someone...... Who I want to see again......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「会いたい人……？」
dialogues.en: "Who you want to see......?"
dialogues.text: "Who you want to see......?"

dialogues.jp: それって……。
dialogues.en: Is that......
dialogues.text: Is that......

dialogues.jp: 「……もしかして、幼なじみの……？」
dialogues.en: "......Is it your childhood friend......?"
dialogues.text: "......Is it your childhood friend......?"

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩は驚いた表情を見せたが、黙って頷く。
dialogues.en:
With a surprised expression, she nodded without saying
anything.
dialogues.text:
With a surprised expression, she nodded without saying
anything.

dialogues.jp:
頭が真っ白になるのが分かった。地に足がつい
ていない感じだ。
dialogues.en:
I felt my mind going blank. It felt as if my legs were
floating off the ground.
dialogues.text:
I felt my mind going blank. It felt as if my legs were
floating off the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「さよなら……」
dialogues.en: "Goodbye......"
dialogues.text: "Goodbye......"

dialogues.jp:
スッと俺の前から離れ、萌先輩が人の流れに紛
れてしまう。
dialogues.en: She walked away from me and blended into the crowd.
dialogues.text: She walked away from me and blended into the crowd.

dialogues.jp:
その姿が、校門の陰に隠れるまで見つづけた後、
俺は背後の桜の木に、身体を傾けた。
dialogues.en:
I followed her with my eyes until she disappeared behind the
gate. Once again I leaned my back against the tree that was
behind me.
dialogues.text:
I followed her with my eyes until she disappeared behind the
gate. Once again I leaned my back against the tree that was
behind me.

dialogues.jp: 俺は……潤みだした瞳を閉じた。
dialogues.en: I closed my tearful eyes......
dialogues.text: I closed my tearful eyes......

dialogues.jp:
ようやく辺りが静かになったころ、俺は校門と
は逆の方向に足を向けた……。
◆拒絶◆
dialogues.en: ◆Breakup◆
dialogues.text: ◆Breakup◆

dialogues.jp: 学園へと向かう途中、萌先輩と出会った。
dialogues.en: I met Moe-sempai on the way to school.
dialogues.text: I met Moe-sempai on the way to school.

dialogues.jp: そして、拒絶された。
dialogues.en: She broke up with me.
dialogues.text: She broke up with me.
